questions.text: What OCC_MAX value is read in the snapshot (number of words)? (Scenario: RUN=1, SLOW_READ=1, the reader pops at most one word per 8 gtref cycles, so the FIFO fills to capacity. After a long time a snapshot is taken by writing 0x030.) Two careful readers of the requirements disagree about this; what is the intended behaviour?
questions.answer: 512. The FIFO fills to capacity, and OCC_MAX is the maximum occupancy seen from the writer side, in words. The FIFO depth is 512 words.
questions.evidence: STALL_W counts writer clock cycles in which the writer had a word to write and the FIFO was full. OCC_MAX is the maximum of the FIFO's occupancy as seen from the writer side (conservative) over all time since CLEAR.

The requirements do not say; what should happen?

questions.text: If RUN is dropped and raised again without CLEAR, should both PRBS sequences, the counters and the FIFO contents carry on from where they stopped, or restart from seed 0x7FFFFFFF? And while RUN is 0, does the reader keep draining and checking the words already in the FIFO?
questions.answer: On RUN 0 to 1 both the writer and the reader start from the seed 0x7FFFFFFF. On RUN 1 to 0 the writer stops first and the reader keeps reading and checking until the FIFO is empty, so the FIFO drains. The counters keep their values until CLEAR. The specification does not say anything more about restarting without CLEAR.
questions.evidence: - RUN 0 to 1 starts both the writer and the reader from the seed; RUN 1 to 0 stops the writer first, then the reader keeps reading until the FIFO is empty. The counters keep their values until CLEAR.

questions.text: After reset, are the counters and the latched snapshot registers (0x014-0x02C) required to read 0 without any CLEAR? (Scenario: RUN=1 for 1 ms with counters non-zero and FIFO partly filled, then rst asserts for 8 clk25 cycles, then released with RUN=0 afterward.) The requirements do not say; what should happen?
questions.answer: Per the reset specification, all counters are 0 after reset, and RUN, SLOW_READ and the FIFO contents are cleared too, so no CLEAR is needed for the counters themselves. The specification does not say what the snapshot holding registers (0x014-0x02C) read after reset until a SNAPSHOT write. That part is not specified.
questions.evidence: Reset: RUN 0, SLOW_READ 0, all counters 0, both sequences at the seed 0x7FFFFFFF, the FIFO empty.

questions.text: Does CLEAR read back as 0 after its effect, and does it self-clear when set during RUN=1 (stay pending until RUN=0, or is discarded)? (Scenario: RUN=0, host sets CLEAR=1 while counters are non-zero, then RUN=1 later is not yet set. Host reads CLEAR bit one cycle after write is accepted and a few cycles later.) The requirements do not say; what should happen?
questions.answer: A CLEAR written while RUN is 1 is ignored (discarded, not held pending until RUN goes to 0). CLEAR is a self-clearing bit, so it is not a sticky flag. The spec does not give the exact clock at which the bit reads back as 0 after a write made while RUN is 0, so that timing is not specified.
questions.evidence: - CLEAR is accepted only while RUN is 0; a CLEAR written while RUN is 1 is ignored. CLEAR also empties the FIFO and restarts both sequences from the seed.

questions.text: Which word is flipped: the word popped in the cycle INJECT is set or the next word popped after INJECT is seen by the gtref domain? (Scenario: INJECT is set while the reader is popping a word on a gtref cycle and the FIFO is empty on the very next cycles, then a word arrives later.) The requirements do not say; what should happen?
questions.answer: The flip applies to the next received word, with bit 0 flipped before the check, and only once. The specification does not say how a word popped in the exact same cycle that INJECT is set is treated, beyond calling the flipped word the 'next received word'.
questions.evidence: INJECT flips bit 0 of the next received word before the check, once; DATA_ERRS then counts 1.

questions.text: Is the writer required to write one word on every clk25 cycle where the FIFO is not full, and is STALL_W incremented on each cycle the FIFO is full? Is STALL_W incremented in a cycle where a pop makes room but the FIFO was full at the start of the cycle? (Scenario: RUN=1, SLOW_READ=1, FIFO has just reached 512 words at cycle 0. Count clk25 cycles over the next 100 cycles with the reader popping one word per 8 gtref cycles (about 51.2 ns per pop, i.e. one pop per ~1.28 clk25 cycles... ).) The requirements do not say; what should happen?
questions.answer: The writer writes one word on every writer clock while the FIFO is not full, and STALL_W counts writer clock cycles in which the writer had a word to write and the FIFO was full. The specification does not settle the edge case of a pop making room in a cycle that started full. It also does not say how the full flag, as seen from the writer side, behaves in that cycle. That part is not specified.
questions.evidence: STALL_W counts writer clock cycles in which the writer had a word to write and the FIFO was full.
